decision_source: hand-reviewed original narratives and native attachments; no semantic/model automation
complete_definition: Sufficient material facts and relevant documents for the disclosed actual path; not every catalog document or every immaterial question.
foundation_definition: Source-supported predicates for an identified tenant request or objection; limited notice objections do not establish overall rights/timeliness.

paths.path: Bedroom mold: repair and possible rent reduction
paths.material_unknowns: Responsibility/technical cause disputed; extent and impairment period; dated landlord knowledge; health causation is separately unknown.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Dated notice/landlord response and reliable defect/impairment record; neutral technical findings to resolve the actual responsibility dispute. Medical proof only if a health-related compensation claim is pursued.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Manager alleges poor ventilation. Coughing does not establish a medical causal link or damages.

paths.path: Boiler failure: emergency repair and deposit safeguards
paths.material_unknowns: Full deposit safeguards, adequate response/repair chronology and any further-remedy severity/period remain unknown: written reasonable deadline, warning/announcement and rent/deposit due dates. Firsthand barely-warm-three-nights/15–17-degree/phone-response account can support a narrow repair request without mandatory calibration or settled cause.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Reliable dated tenant account and landlord notice/response can support repair assessment; a service report or calibrated reading is not universally required. For the separately requested deposit path: actual written deadline, delivery, deposit warning/announcement, tenancy rent/due-date terms; canton-designated deposit destination must be verified before action.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Thermometer explicitly uncalibrated; temporary units reported insufficient. Calibration is not itself a statutory prerequisite; other reliable severity evidence could suffice.

paths.path: Renovation termination: reason review and hardship extension
paths.material_unknowns: Actual termination notice, receipt and lease expiry/term; intended works schedule and vacancy need; hardship balance and any statutory extension exclusion.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Complete termination packet and receipt evidence; relevant lease termination terms, dated works plan/reason, accessibility needs and housing-search records to support the requested extension balance.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: General project brochure does not establish when vacant possession is necessary; six rejections and 17-year residence are reported, not corroborated.

paths.path: Renovation grant allocation: substantive increase review
paths.material_unknowns: Grant/building/project match and recoverable net/allocated costs; communicated increase and receipt; relevant calculation and rent baseline.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Actual grant decision identifying the building/projects; rent notice and cost allocation/breakdown with subsidies; prior rent basis; notification evidence for the applicable challenge clock.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Three project numbers and a manager address do not prove this building received the grant. A reported zero-subsidy line is not proof of fraudulent allocation.

paths.path: Conflicting termination forms: controlling notice and dates
paths.material_unknowns: Which notice is a replacement, exact service dates and year of termination; completeness of actual communicated originals, signature/issuer status and lease notice terms.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Missing page 2 of both received scans; actual envelopes/service records; written replacement/correction statement and relevant lease terms. A missing scan page is not proof the landlord omitted it on service.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Received forms specify different end dates; each is physically one page marked 1/2. Blank reason fields alone do not invalidate a termination: reasons are required on request under Art. 271(2).

paths.path: Ancillary charges moved into net rent: increase/change review
paths.material_unknowns: Legally operative prior rent/ancillary basis, rationale/classification of changed charges; receipt and applicable notice terms.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Existing three-page form is page-complete. Needed: relevant lease/prior binding rent notice and ancillary-cost basis; notice receipt and calculation supporting the stated cost adjustment. Full catalog documents are not presumed required.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: The form states old/new net figures, resolving what it says about the baseline, but not proving the prior legally binding basis. Small gross change does not exclude a material net-rent increase.

paths.path: Rent arrears termination: cure and payment timing
paths.material_unknowns: Due rent debt, written cure warning and its service; actual cure expiry and bank payment value/receipt time; subsequent termination packet/service; family-home applicability.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Cure demand/warning, delivery record, bank payment and landlord ledger, complete termination packet and receipt; relevant tenancy rent/due-date terms. Spouse service only if family-home facts apply.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: One month of lateness is admitted. Paying before termination does not by itself prove payment within the statutory cure period; internal posting and bank payment must be separated.

paths.path: Family-home forms with different dates: service and extension
paths.material_unknowns: Exact dated receipts for both spouses; intended common end date/correction; completeness of spouse's communicated original; hardship balance and extension exclusions.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Tenant copy has both printed pages; spouse copy lacks page 2. Needed actual full spouse notice, separate service records, clarification of intended termination date, lease terms and support for any extension hardship.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Different June/July dates are observed. Separate service is reported rather than absent; a missing spouse scan page does not establish invalid original service.

paths.path: Plain email termination PDF: formal nullity challenge
paths.material_unknowns: Additional paper notice/channels and receipt dates; authority of actual issuer; tenancy linkage. Any independent later approved-form notice needs its own assessment.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Received one-page plain letter is fully readable, visibly unsigned and not the canton-approved form. Needed original accompanying email/issuer authority, complete channel archive or clear confirmation of the sole notification packet, and dated receipt.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: The received landlord letter's form failure supports the tenant's objection; it does not make the tenant claim invalid. Another valid notice could alter the overall tenancy position.

paths.path: Recurring mold: disputed responsibility review
paths.material_unknowns: Building cause versus tenant responsibility, ventilation pattern, affected extent/period and landlord knowledge.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Actual caretaker/manager statements, dated landlord notice and defect timeline; neutral climate/building findings to resolve the stated causation conflict. A photo is received evidence, not a causal report.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Caretaker's cold-wall account conflicts with manager's tenant-blame account; neither attribution is established merely by being reported.

paths.path: Possible repeated reference-rate factor: baseline reconciliation
paths.material_unknowns: Whether the earlier notified increase took effect, actual rent charged/paid and binding base; current notice and receipt.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Earlier/current notices and calculations, ledger and bank payment records for the relevant period, and relevant lease/rent baseline; current communication/receipt for deadlines.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Manager alleges an earlier system error. Inconsistent standing orders and annual accounts do not themselves establish double charging.

paths.path: Dampness with disputed inspection access
paths.material_unknowns: Actual access attempts/arrival times and clock offset for the requested reconciliation; a confirmed new appointment. Technical causation is deliberately left open and cannot block inspection arrangement.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Actual appointment records, contractor notes and door log with clock offset explained, or equivalent reliable dated accounts for reconciliation; a confirmed new access arrangement. A technical causal report is not required before arranging inspection.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Contractor reports no answer; tenant reports no ring. Clock discrepancy leaves a potential access defence unresolved, without establishing obstruction.

paths.path: Renovation increase: recoverable cost review
paths.material_unknowns: Relevant value-adding costs versus maintenance, subsidies and allocation; full notice, previous rent basis and actual receipt.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Actual increase packet, itemized project/cost/subsidy allocation, prior binding rent basis and receipt evidence. Primary CO supports the issue, but ordinance-specific percentages cannot be concluded from CO alone.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: A total-only letter is reported; lack of an understandable breakdown does not alone prove that the increase is legally abusive.

paths.path: Family-home termination: possible absent separate spouse service
paths.material_unknowns: Spouse's separate service is both denied and expressly unresolved; complete notice, receipt, landlord reason and extension balance.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Actual termination packet and separate spouse/tenant service evidence or reliable absence confirmation; lease terms and dated hardship/search records for the requested extension.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Tenant says wife did not receive a form, while explicitly asking whether separate delivery occurred. This is a potential tenant nullity ground, not a proven failure or an invalid tenant claim.

paths.path: Multi-unit leak: repair coordination and deposit deadline
paths.material_unknowns: Leak source and affected flats, dated notice/knowledge; exact deposit stage and statutory deadlines; safe joint access.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Actual contractor notes and affected-flat evidence, landlord response/access plan; for deposit: written reasonable repair deadline with warning/announcement, relevant rent due dates and any deposit receipt/first-deposit due date.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Cold-water versus drain accounts conflict. Manager acknowledgment is reported, but not an attached admission. Unknown source need not prevent an urgent repair request; it prevents the requested full technical/deposit assessment.

paths.path: Repaired minor leak: record and closure review
paths.material_unknowns: Exact incident/repair period remains unresolved for the specifically requested chronology/record review. No current defect, residual impairment or damages is asserted.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Minimal dated repair/incident confirmation or customer clarification for the requested record check. Technical reports, deposit documents and medical documents are not prerequisites for ordinary administrative closure.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Manager responded next morning; repair and continuing dryness are reported. That is adverse to a new removal demand, but consistent with requested closure. No live substantive remedy is actually requested.

paths.path: Mold behind furniture: disputed use and neutral inspection
paths.material_unknowns: Ventilation and furniture clearance/access; responsibility, building condition and meaningful humidity record; landlord notice.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Actual humidity log, contradictory caretaker/partner accounts and accessible-area photos; dated notice and neutral climate/building inspection appropriate to this dispute.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Wardrobe flush-to-wall versus ten-centimetre gap is disputed; four evenings of measurements do not establish a complete climate history. Neither version proves tenant fault.

paths.path: Mixed debt demand: rent cure versus repair invoice
paths.material_unknowns: Outstanding rent after payment, actual allocation and value date; service/cure expiry; legal scope of warning; termination notice/receipt; family-home applicability.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Received one-page payment demand distinguishes rent/repair/fees and states 30 days after receipt. Needed delivery, bank/ledger allocation, relevant tenancy terms and the actual subsequent termination packet/service. Spouse records only if applicable.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Rent CHF1680, refrigerator repair CHF420, fees CHF35, total CHF2135 are documented. Including non-rent repair debt raises a warning-scope issue, but does not automatically nullify an otherwise identifiable rent demand. Tenant says only rent was paid.

paths.path: Increase without approved form plus termination threat
paths.material_unknowns: Exact full communication and any contemporaneous packet for an overall validity determination; delivery/date and rent arrangement for distinct form/deadline questions. The stated increase-or-termination threat supplies an independent269d(2)(c) objection even if269c changes the form requirement.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Actual landlord letter/message or reliable full-content account and any contemporaneous packet are useful to verify the exact threat; relevant rent arrangement and notification evidence only for applicable form/clock questions. Missing attachment or delivery uncertainty alone does not defeat the reported nullity ground.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Customer expressly reports an increase accompanied by a termination threat, supporting a limited tenant269d(2)(c) objection. No-form objection is separately subject to form exceptions; step-rent form relaxation does not remove the independent threat ground.

paths.path: Full increase form with blank substantive reason
paths.material_unknowns: Complete contemporaneous communication packet and relation/date of later email; notification date and applicable ordinary/stepped rent arrangement. Substantive calculation merits remain separate.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Received form has all three pages, amounts and date, but no substantive reason printed. Needed any original accompanying reason letter/email and later email with dates, whole-packet confirmation and receipt. Calculation documents are unnecessary to a proven no-reasons nullity ground, but necessary for substantive rent merits.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Blank reason is observed and potentially founds the tenant challenge. Standard accompanying-letter label does not prove a letter existed. Typed signature is not automatically invalid: Art.269d(4) permits mechanical reproduction from 1Oct2025.

paths.path: Repeated heating failure: repair and possible further remedies
paths.material_unknowns: Full reduction-period/quantum and responsibility/technical context remain unknown for the broad further-remedies review. The firsthand16-degree/reset/three-call account can support a narrow repair demand without calibration or a settled technical cause.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Reliable dated tenant account, notice/call record or acknowledgment can support repair assessment; technical report/calibration is not mandatory. Relevant landlord-knowledge/impairment period and rent only for reduction; loss/causation/medical proof only if an actual related damages demand is pursued; deposit documents only if that route is requested.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: About16 degrees and repeated resets are reported; three calls suggest notice but do not establish recipient/date/content. Unknown cause should not delay reporting or protective heating assessment.

paths.path: Possibly miscalculated increase: form, baseline and deadline
paths.material_unknowns: Prior reference-rate/rent baseline, actual current figures/form and exact receipt.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Current increase packet, last binding rent notice/calculation or relevant lease baseline, and reliable notification date. Rate/amount arithmetic cannot be established from a concern that figures look high.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Previous calculation is expressly not found. Concern about high figures and deadlines is not an established excessive return or computation error.

paths.path: Apparently retroactive increase: receipt and notice dates
paths.material_unknowns: Actual notification date, stated effective date and relevant lease termination/notice term; timing relationship remains expressly unresolved.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Actual complete form and relevant lease notice clauses; alternative reliable service/receipt confirmation because envelope was discarded. An envelope is not the only legally usable delivery evidence.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Yesterday versus first-of-month is reported, suggesting a timing objection, but the original notice is absent and dates/terms not fixed. Incorrect timing is distinct from Art.269d(2) express nullity grounds.

paths.path: Acknowledged recurring leak: official deposit safeguards
paths.material_unknowns: Exact recurrence/repair state and dated landlord knowledge; contents, adequacy/service/expiry of written deadline, warning/announcement and any deposit stage/due dates.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Actual landlord acknowledgment and written repair deadline/notice with receipt; current defect/repair record. For deposit, precise future rent/due date and canton-designated destination; if deposited, first-deposit due date and conciliation filing record/clock.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Acknowledgment and an expired deadline are reported, but not received as documents. A JPEG can show visible pipe/water conditions; it cannot prove statutory warnings or30-day deposit safeguards.

paths.path: Unfinished renovation and estimated costs: increase review
paths.material_unknowns: Actual completion, final versus forecast recoverable costs/subsidies, applicable notice/receipt and rent baseline.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Original increase packet, estimate and actual works/cost/subsidy records, relevant rent basis, receipt; specialist ordinance review needed before any precise recoverable-cost or completion-rule determination.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Two unfinished sides, estimate and undecided grant are reported. Current sources do not establish the ultimate recoverable amount; CO alone is not a percentage calculator.

paths.path: Reference-rate date discrepancy: source table and baseline
paths.material_unknowns: Which table/publication period was used, preparation/signature dates and actual baseline; notification date.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Current and prior notices/calculations and actual referenced published rate table, with dates/receipt. No such notice or table is attached despite the report of having found one.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Tenant expressly allows that the table may be misread. A stated two-week chronology difference is not proof of an invalid or abusive increase.

paths.path: Sewage backflow: containment, repair, deposit and costs
paths.material_unknowns: Technical source/extent and dated persistence/notice; repair/deposit safeguards; costs actually incurred, amount and health/loss causation.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Current dated contamination/technical and landlord-response record. For requested deposit, actual written deadline/warning/announcement and rent/deposit dates; for costs, receipts and causal support. Medical evidence only for a health-compensation claim, not containment.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Untimestamped photos and pharmacy attendance are reported but no photos/receipts are attached. Rash alone does not establish backflow causation. Urgent containment does not depend on proving health damages.

paths.path: Possible retaliatory termination after defect notice
paths.material_unknowns: Actual notice/receipt, dated rights assertion and causal motive/own-use evidence; full chronology and notice form.
paths.route_relevant_documents_or_equivalent_r: Original written damp-wall notice and complete termination packet with delivery dates; landlord's requested reason and available own-use/counterevidence. Timing is an indicator, not a finding of retaliation.
paths.adverse_or_limiting_facts: Two-week sequence and previously unmentioned own use are reported. Neither genuine own use nor retaliatory motive is established.
